summary: Added one real-tree Fact, TopLevelTests.AnInPlaceCorrectionOfARootLevelFileNameMarksThatFileRowRevised, and changed no src. It hardlinks root\a-stale.bin to sub\current.bin, grows the file by 63 MiB through the sub name, and scans with Watch(correctedRows: ["a-stale.bin"]). The snapshot-0 assert (File, Done, 1 MiB, not Revised) comes first, per m2. The final assert is the literal-true Revised tuple, and sub is asserted unrevised. The SL-105 repro now passes and the whole default suite is 936/936. For M1 and m1 I committed Mutants.ps1 (mutant A, TopLevel filter, 42 s, kills exactly this Fact on 'row a-stale.bin: Revised is False') and a leaked-copy sweep with its own corpus. The tree I was handed held only untracked files (the repro project, .taad/slices/SL-105, .taad-scratch) and no modified tracked files. The repro project is kept unchanged. .taad-scratch is the earlier stages' scratch and I left it alone.

obligations.how: C-001: the Fact is in the default suite, so the repro now reads a unit with a root-level Hardlink(tree.PathOf("a-stale.bin")), Append, Watch, EntryKind.File and the literal-true Revised tuple. The repro command went from exit 1 to exit 0 (1/1).

C-002: the Fact feeds in a FILE row directly under the root whose root listing is stale, because the file grew through sub\current.bin. It asserts the final row is (File, Done, 64 MiB, Revised true) with OnDisk equal to the store's. It passes on unmutated src, and the TopLevel filter is 25/25.

C-003: assertion 2, placed straight after Completed, requires snapshot 0's a-stale.bin to be (File, Done, 1 MiB, Revised false). I confirmed that a non-stale fixture (Append before Hardlink) fails exactly there: expected 1048576, actual 67108864, TopLevelTests.cs:136.

C-004: the Fact asserts sub is (Done, 0 bytes, Files 1, Folders 1, Revised false) and passes corrected rows ["a-stale.bin"] only, so the watcher's `corrected || !row.Revised` clause also covers sub in every snapshot.

C-005: tests/bugs/SL-105-FileRowRevisedGuard/Mutants.ps1 gates the latch with `r.Kind != EntryKind.File &&` in a copy. Result: 25 of 25 tests run as in the unmutated copy, and exactly TopLevelTests.AnInPlaceCorrectionOfARootLevelFileNameMarksThatFileRowRevised goes red, with 'row a-stale.bin: Revised is False' in the message, under both temp folders. The worktree src hash is unchanged and git diff --exit-code src is 0. Exit 0 in 42 s.

C-006: Mutants.ps1 -Temp Engine runs the TopLevel tests, the new Fact included, with TEMP and TMP set to %SystemRoot%\TEMP, on the unmutated copy and under the mutant. It passes: 25/25 baseline, and the mutant kills only the Fact. TempTree.ChooseTestsRoot keeps the tree in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp\fsa-tests.

C-007: the full default suite (eng/dotnet.ps1 test FsAnalyser.slnx, default filter, parallel collections) passed 936/936 in 31 s, up from 935, and exit 0. The Fact carries no Trait, so the default VSTestTestCaseFilter includes it.

M1: Mutants.ps1 is committed in the slice folder, modelled on SL-102's. It copies via git ls-files without untracked .taad/ and .taad-scratch/, and refuses a target under the worktree or a link. It requires the old text exactly once and builds --no-incremental, and the run is void unless Core.dll was written after the edit or the test count differs from baseline. It uses the worktree's .dotnet through DOTNET_ROOT and PATH, and ends with a src digest plus git diff --exit-code src. SL-102's ValidateSet is untouched.

mutation.find: New = 'if (r.Kind != EntryKind.File && state == TopLevelState.Done && (r.Bytes, r.OnDisk) != (r.SettledBytes, r.SettledOnDisk))'

obligations.how: m1: Mutants.ps1 starts by running Remove-StaleScratchRoots over %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp (ScratchRoots.ps1). Copies are named fsa-sl105-mutant-<pid>-<hex8> and are swept when that pid is not a live PowerShell. Build servers are shut down once, before the first removal (the copies carry no SDK, and the servers are shared machine-wide per SDK, so once covers every root). Read-only files are cleared, and a copy that cannot be removed is reported 'stuck' while the sweep carries on. No SDK is copied or bootstrapped. Corpus ScratchRootCorpus.json has 11 rows, S01-S11. With -Before (no sweep) 10 checks fail: S01-S08 plus the shutdown check and the S01 removed-now check. After the fix all rows hold under pwsh 7 and powershell.exe 5.1. A real run killed mid-build with taskkill /T left its copy, and the next run swept it.

m2: the snapshot-0 assert now sits directly after the Completed assert, before Probes and the flags assert. I checked it by building the refreshed-entry shape (Append before Hardlink) in the real test file and restoring it by bytes. The Fact failed at the snapshot-0 line (TopLevelTests.cs:136) with Expected (File, Done, 1048576, False) / Actual (File, Done, 67108864, False), not at the flags assert.
obligations.not_mutable: The order of two asserts changes nothing on a correct fixture, so no replacement turns a test red. It only decides which assert reports first once the fixture is already broken, and there is no seam to break it from a test. I measured that case by hand, as described.

cases.test_name: tests/bugs/SL-105-FileRowRevisedGuard/Mutants.ps1 -Temp Engine: the Fact passes unmutated and is the only red under mutant A with TEMP=TMP=%SystemRoot%\TEMP
FsAnalyser.Core.Tests.TopLevelTests.AnInPlaceCorrectionOfARootLevelFileNameMarksThatFileRowRevised inside the whole default suite (936 tests)

tests.note: 25/25 including the new Fact. Re-run after the by-hand check of the refreshed-fixture shape and the restore of the file.
1/1; it was exit 1 before the Fact. Not edited.
936/936, exit 0, 31 s (935 plus the new Fact).
Exit 0 in 42 s. Mutant A is killed by exactly the new Fact under both temps, with the message 'row a-stale.bin: Revised is False'; the worktree src is untouched. -Temp Engine alone also passed.
Expected failure. The pre-fix shape sweeps nothing, so 10 of the checks fail: S01-S08, the build-server shutdown and the S01 removed-now check.
All 11 rows held under pwsh 7, and again under powershell.exe 5.1. No fsa-sl105-* folder is left in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp.

tests.command: Mutants.ps1 started by Start-Process, killed with taskkill /T /F mid-build, then Mutants.ps1 -Temp Engine run
tests.note: The killed run left fsa-sl105-mutant-40212-ddf030ba, and the next run printed 'swept: fsa-sl105-mutant-40212-ddf030ba'. A second run whose output pipe was cut left its copy and showed as 'kept' while its owner was still alive. The next full run finished with no copy left.

tests.command: by-hand mutation checks: O-010 (Mutants.ps1 with a no-op mutant) and O-011 (ScratchRoots.ps1 without the delete), each file restored by bytes and hash
tests.note: Both runs exit 1 with the expected FAIL lines, so both mutations bite. This is the evidence for the two `mutation` entries.

deviations: Mutants.ps1 builds tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests.csproj (with its project references) --no-incremental, not FsAnalyser.slnx as SL-102's does, and runs the TopLevel filter, not the whole suite. The slnx build adds the WPF App and the other projects for no benefit here, and the engine's case runner ends a case at 120 s (Q-222). The run takes 42 s.

The sweep shuts the build servers down once before the first removal, not once per stale root. m1 said 'for each'. The copies carry no SDK of their own because DOTNET_ROOT points at the worktree's .dotnet, and build servers are shared per SDK, so a per-root shutdown would repeat the same call.

A directory under the fsa-sl105-mutant- prefix with no process id in its name (the form the design's prose gave: fsa-sl105-mutant-<guid>) is treated as stale and swept, since nothing else makes that prefix. Corpus row S07.

The design counted three files for this slice (the Fact plus the two repro source files). The accepted M1 and m1 findings added four more under the slice's own tests/bugs folder: Mutants.ps1, ScratchRoots.ps1, ScratchRootCorpus.json and ScratchRootCorpus.Tests.ps1. Nothing outside the slice's folder changed apart from TopLevelTests.cs.
not_built: No standing mutant roster for TopLevelTracker and no change to SL-102's Mutants.ps1 ValidateSet. The design filed it for later.

No Windows 10 run (O-009 is owed to validate-slice). The NTFS per-name staleness was measured only on Windows 11 build 26200, and the Fact would fail loudly at its snapshot-0 assert, not pass vacuously, if Windows 10 behaved differently.

No fixture for a junction or symlink inside a scratch copy, or for a delete denied by an ACL. The corpus's bounded_by line says these are out of the class: a copy is made of plain files in the user's own temp.
follow_ups: Nothing runs tests/bugs/SL-105-FileRowRevisedGuard/ScratchRootCorpus.Tests.ps1 or Mutants.ps1 on a routine basis. They sit outside FsAnalyser.slnx like the other tests/bugs scripts (Q-249). Register them as catalog rows if the person wants the mutant kill re-proved at every later validate.
A standing, repeatable mutant roster for TopLevelTracker (the kind-gated latch, and Seed building before Settle), as the design filed. Run it when src/FsAnalyser.Core/TopLevel*.cs changes.

HardlinkTests.ALoneNameUnderTheRootIsChargedAtItsOwnSize builds the same root-level stale shape and still never asserts TopLevel. It is not the right home for the guard, but its comment could point to the new Fact.
